subject: Concatenation expressions
notes: kb/Work PB1406 (w62k). cite.py --check 8.8.3.1 "exactly one of `literal-1` or `concatenation-expression-1` shall be selected as the left operand" -> OK. literal-1/literal-2 admit the two WORDS that stand for a literal: a constant-name (--check 13.10.3 "constant-name-1 may be used anywhere that a format specifies a literal of the class and category of constant-name-1" -> OK SR2) and a symbolic-character (--check 12.3.7.4 "Symbolic-character-1 defines a figurative constant" -> OK GR11). concatOperand gained a cobolWord arm; ConcatFolder resolves it through LiteralEnvironment (constant first, then symbolic-character), a word naming neither -> COBOL2473. Before: "X" & SYM-A / "X" & K were COBOL0309 and SYM-A & "X" COBOL0001 (probes w62k/probe/q01-q03); after: XA / AX / XQ. At 85 the & operator is refused COBOL0900 (concat_below_2002). The ALL literal-1 concatenation (§8.3.3.6.3 SR2) is a separate arm reported as a lead, not this row. retired-witness: conformance:2002/pb1406_concat_word_operands (the golden moved to the 2014 corpus: it writes a zero-length literal, a COBOL-2014 introduction gated by kb/Work PB895 (same program, same expected output))
